scope: 23new photos/66objects, no imageID or byte overlap with original40; train25/val8 labels and pixels unchanged. Configuration frozen before human approval/evaluation. No tuning after these results. Small class coverage; binary duplication checked, perceptual similarity not checked.

approval.reference: Aprovo as 23 fotos para teste local
approval.use: localtest only; not training or publication of photos

native_metrics_note: Native class-average metrics use confidence sweep/maxF1 point; not the fixed0.10 application counts. Native plots use another operating threshold.
